acceptance_criteria: Declared dependencies produce a deterministic topological order with stable tie-breaking.
A dependency cycle is rejected with a stable structured diagnostic and no plan.
Reordered equivalent inputs of a cycle-free graph produce an equal ordered plan.
applicability: Phase 1 XDL Lite bounded software allocation (offline declared experiment intent compilation). status 'accepted' records internal engineering intent only; it is not implementation satisfaction or external delivery acceptance.
statement: The compiler shall derive a deterministic dependency order from declared dependencies and shall reject a dependency cycle or competing-order ambiguity with a stable structured diagnostic; equal declared inputs shall produce an equal ordered result.
title: Deterministic dependency order and cycle rejection
verification_intent: Planned to be exercised through the XDL1-UNIT, XDL1-STATIC, XDL1-INTEGRATION, and XDL1-VALIDATION measures defined in the XDL1 verification-design stage, invoking the real loader, schema registry, catalog, activation-plan consumer, and additive CLI/API. No runtime, availability, compatibility, or readiness claim is made.
